title: VaultSMP Administrator Utilities
body:
# VaultSMP Administrator Utilities
This mod adds features that help admins on survival servers.
# Features
### Admin Panel
The Admin Panel is an ingame panel that can be opened with `.`

In it you can see a list of all Players and if there online or not. You can also see usefull information about the players such as:
- HP and Hunger
- Location
- Inventory and E-chest
- chat log
- Gamemode

In the GUI there are buttons that have various funktions such as:
- Giving Regeneration
- Giving Saturation
- looking in the Players E-chest
- Banning the Player
- Highlighting the Player (only Visible to Admins)

chat logs get saved in the server files under: ...\Server\adminutility\chatlogs

### Zone Block
The Zone Block is a utility Block that sets non operators into adventure mode when they enter the radius and get changed back when they exit
- You can toggle the visibility of the borders with a button that can be changed in the control settings
- you can change the radius of the block
- Players in it dont recieve damage
- inside the zone explosions do not destroy blocks
- Block cant be mined or destroyed
- Block can be found in the operator item tab in the creative inventory
